summary: This directory manages the internal lifecycle of application configuration, handling the retrieval, transformation, and integration of static and environment-based configuration data before it is consumed by the application.
responsibilities: Resolve and load static JSON configuration files
Decode and validate raw configuration structures
Merge multiple configuration sources using specific strategies
Sort configuration layers based on precedence
Transform configuration objects by processing option values
relationships: Configuration loading uses path resolution to retrieve raw data from static files or environment sources.
Loaded configuration fragments are sorted by layer order before being merged into a single coherent configuration.
Data transformation processes, such as unwrapping options, are applied to configurations to ensure they meet expected schemas.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of core loading logic within an internal scope to prevent external dependency coupling
Recursive transformation patterns for processing nested configuration objects
Separation of concerns between source retrieval, validation, and merging strategies
